fields.description: KORE by Imtiaz is a wellness-focused residence in Dubailand. Its design combines exercise facilities, gardens and places to recover, with shared outdoor spaces for work, family time and recreation.

overview: Plans show four studio, four one-bedroom and one two-bedroom A-type layouts, the latter with a maid’s room. Whole-home totals are absent.
research.locationNote: The plan cover identifies Dubai Land Residence Complex, Wadi Al Safa 5; the developer says Dubailand.
research.priceNote: Release references: studios AED 679,000; one-bedroom AED 1.1 million; two-bedroom AED 1.55 million. Current unit quotations require confirmation.
research.paymentNote: Alternative: 20% booking, 35% construction, 5% completion, 40% over three years. Printed 3.33% quarterly totals 39.96% across twelve payments; confirm the adjustment.
research.handoverNote: Release target Q4 2028 matches Property Finder’s December 2028. Actual completion and current progress remain unverified.
unresolved: Brochure work-in-progress notes require contractual confirmation of equipment and wellness services; no medical benefits are validated.
